async function loadFloor() {
  const f = await getJSON("/api/floor");

  if (!f.running && !Object.keys(FL.cands).length && (f.last?.ideas || []).length) flReplay(f.last);
  $("#fl-model").textContent = f.llm ? "MODEL " + f.model : "لا يوجد نموذج";
  $("#fl-nollm").classList.toggle("hidden", f.llm);
  $("#fl-run").disabled = !f.llm || f.running;
}
$("#fl-run").onclick = async () => {
  const r = await fetch("/api/floor/run?n=" + (($("#fl-n") || {}).value || 6), {method: "POST"});
  if (!r.ok) { const j = await r.json(); $("#fl-phase-text").textContent = j.reason === "no_llm" ? "لازم توصل نموذج الأول: GEMINI_API_KEY في Render." : "الفريق شغال بالفعل."; }
};

const FL_OPT_DEF = {layout: "3", dens: "compact", chat: "all", n: "6"};
function flOpts() {
  let o = {...FL_OPT_DEF};
  try { Object.assign(o, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fl.opts") || "{}")); } catch (e) {}
  const apply = () => {
    const g = $("#fl-grid"); if (!g) return;
    g.dataset.chat = o.chat;
    document.querySelectorAll("#fl-opts .seg").forEach(sg => sg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.v === o[sg.dataset.o])));
    try { localStorage.setItem("fl.opts", JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) {}
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  };
  document.querySelectorAll("#fl-opts .seg").forEach(sg => sg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { o[sg.dataset.o] = b.dataset.v; apply(); }));
  const ns = $("#fl-n"); if (ns) { ns.value = o.n; ns.onchange = () => { o.n = ns.value; apply(); }; }
  FL.opts = o;
  apply();
}
function flChart(sym) {
  FL.chartSym = sym; FL.ttab = null;
  Object.entries(FL.cands).forEach(([k, r]) => r.classList.toggle("sel", k === sym));
  const el = $("#fl-chart"), p = FL.props[sym] || {};
  // the AI Trading Dashboard chart widget alone (/pro?only=chart): its own symbols, timeframes, indicators, drawings
  $("#fl-chart-t").textContent = sym;
  $("#fl-chart-hint").textContent = p.decision === "propose" ? `الفريق: ${p.direction > 0 ? "شراء" : "بيع"} · دخول ${fmt(p.entry)} · وقف ${fmt(p.stop)} · T1 ${fmt(p.t1)}` : (p.thesis ? p.thesis.slice(0, 120) : "");
  flLevels(sym);
  const src = `/pro?lang=${typeof LANG !== "undefined" ? LANG : "ar"}&only=chart&sym=${encodeURIComponent(sym)}`;
  const fr = el.querySelector("iframe");
  if (!fr || fr.dataset.sym !== sym) el.innerHTML = `<iframe class="fl-pro" data-sym="${esc(sym)}" src="${src}" title="chart"></iframe>`;
  flShowTools(sym);
}
function flReplay(last) {
  FL.lastRun = last;
  (last.ideas || []).forEach(i => {
    const p = i.proposal || (i.status === "PASS" ? {decision: "pass", thesis: i.reason} :
      {decision: "propose", direction: i.direction, entry: i.entry, stop: i.stop, t1: i.t1, t2: i.t2, thesis: i.thesis, confirmations: i.confirmations});
    onFloor({type: "proposal", symbol: i.symbol, proposal: p});
    Object.entries(i.confirmations || {}).forEach(([a, v]) => {
      const dot = FL.cands[i.symbol].querySelector(`.dot[data-a="${a}"]`);
      if (dot) dot.className = "dot " + ({agree: p.direction > 0 ? "bullish" : "bearish", disagree: p.direction > 0 ? "bearish" : "bullish"}[v] || "neutral");
    });
    FL.deb[i.symbol] = {bull: i.bull || "", bear: i.bear || ""};
    if (i.bull) $(".bb .b", FL.cands[i.symbol]).textContent = "BULL " + i.bull.slice(0, 90);
    if (i.bear) $(".bb .r", FL.cands[i.symbol]).textContent = "BEAR " + i.bear.slice(0, 90);
    onFloor({type: "decision", symbol: i.symbol, status: i.status, vetoes: i.vetoes || [], notes: i.notes || []});
    // the chat keeps the round's arguments and verdicts after a reload
    if (i.bull) flChat({from: "bull", to: "bear", kind: "debate", text: i.bull, symbol: i.symbol});
    if (i.bear) flChat({from: "bear", to: "bull", kind: "debate", text: i.bear, symbol: i.symbol});
    flChat({from: "gate", to: "all", kind: "decision", symbol: i.symbol,
            text: `${i.status}${(i.vetoes || []).length ? " · " + i.vetoes.join("؛ ") : ""}${i.status === "PASS" && i.reason ? " · " + i.reason : ""}`});
  });
  const ago = Math.round((Date.now() / 1000 - (last.time || 0)) / 60);
  $("#fl-phase-text").textContent = `آخر جولة من ${ago} د`; flKpis();
}

RETRY_STATUS = {408, 409, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
USAGE: Counter = Counter()   # successful calls per provider, shown in the UI


def providers(model: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Main model first, then LLM_FALLBACKS in order (free first, paid last)."""
    out = []
    if config.LLM_BASE_URL and (model or config.LLM_MODEL):
        out.append({"name": model or config.LLM_MODEL, "base_url": config.LLM_BASE_URL,
                    "model": model or config.LLM_MODEL, "key": [REDACTED]
    for f in config.LLM_FALLBACKS:
        if f.get("base_url") and f.get("model"):
            out.append({"name": f.get("name") or f["model"], "base_url": f["base_url"], "model": f["model"],
                        "key": [REDACTED]"key_env"], "").strip() if f.get("key_env") else ""})
    return out


def available() -> bool:
    return bool(providers())


def _extra(base_url: str) -> dict:
    return config.LLM_EXTRA.get(urlparse(base_url).hostname or "", {})


_pace_lock = threading.Lock()
_next_slot = [0.0]


def _pace() -> None:
    """Space calls to config.LLM_RPM per minute across all threads (free tiers reject bursts with 429)."""
    if config.LLM_RPM <= 0:
        return
    gap = 60.0 / config.LLM_RPM
    with _pace_lock:
        now = time.monotonic()
        slot = max(now, _next_slot[0])
        _next_slot[0] = slot + gap
    if slot > now:
        time.sleep(slot - now)


def _complete(body: dict, model: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """POST chat/completions down the provider chain. A 429/5xx is retried on the same provider
    with backoff (Retry-After when given); any other failure moves to the next provider."""
    errors = []
    for p in providers(model):
        b = dict(body, model=p["model"], **_extra(p["base_url"]))
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if p["key"]:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {p['key']}"
        url = p["base_url"].rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
        for attempt in range(config.LLM_RETRIES + 1):
            _pace()
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(b), timeout=config.LLM_TIMEOUT)
            except requests.RequestException as e:
                errors.append(f"{p['name']}: {e.__class__.__name__}")
                break
            if r.status_code == 400 and _extra(p["base_url"]) and attempt == 0:
                b = dict(body, model=p["model"])  # provider rejected an extra field: try plain
                continue
            if r.status_code in RETRY_STATUS and attempt < config.LLM_RETRIES:
                try:
                    wait = float(r.headers.get("Retry-After", ""))
                except ValueError:
                    wait = 2.0 * (attempt + 1)
                time.sleep(min(max(wait, 0.5), config.LLM_MAX_WAIT))
                continue
            if r.status_code >= 400:
                try:  # the provider's own reason (e.g. "model ... is no longer available"), first 120 chars
                    why = str((r.json()[0] if isinstance(r.json(), list) else r.json())["error"]["message"])[:120]
                except Exception:
                    why = ""
                errors.append(f"{p['name']}: HTTP {r.status_code}" + (f" ({why})" if why else ""))
                break
            try:
                msg = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]
            except Exception:
                errors.append(f"{p['name']}: bad response")
                break
            USAGE[p["name"]] += 1
            return msg
        else:
            errors.append(f"{p['name']}: HTTP {r.status_code} بعد {config.LLM_RETRIES + 1} محاولات")
    raise RuntimeError("كل النماذج فشلت: " + "؛ ".join(errors or ["لا يوجد نموذج مضبوط"]))

        cands = [c for c in (plan.get("candidates") or []) if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("symbol") in UNIVERSE][:self.n]
        cands = list({c["symbol"]: c for c in cands}.values())
        if len(cands) < self.n:
            # the head picked fewer than asked: top up from the watchlist by score, one asset class at a time
            rows = (await asyncio.to_thread(T.call, room.ctx, "watchlist", {}))[1]["data"]["rows"]
            have = {c["symbol"] for c in cands}
            by_kind: dict[str, list] = {}
            for r in sorted(rows, key=[REDACTED] r: -(r.get("score") or 0)):
                if r["symbol"] in UNIVERSE and r["symbol"] not in have and not r.get("blocked"):
                    by_kind.setdefault(UNIVERSE[r["symbol"]]["kind"], []).append(r)
            while len(cands) < self.n and any(by_kind.values()):
                for k in list(by_kind):
                    if by_kind[k] and len(cands) < self.n:
                        r = by_kind[k].pop(0)
                        cands.append({"symbol": r["symbol"], "direction": r.get("direction") or 1,
                                      "why": f"من الـ watchlist (score {r.get('score')}) عشان نغطي {k}"})
        for c in cands:
            c["direction"] = 1 if int(c.get("direction", 1) or 1) >= 0 else -1
        if not cands:
            await room.bus("head", "all", "decision", "مفيش سوق يستاهل النهارده. أحسن قرار إننا نستنى.")
            return await self._finish(room, [], t0, plan)
        for c in cands:
            await room.bus("head", "team", "assign", f"{c['symbol']} ({_dir_word(c['direction'])} مبدئياً): {c.get('why', '')}", c["symbol"])

        # ---------------------------------------------------------- 2 specialists in parallel
        await room.say({"type": "phase", "phase": "analysis", "title": "2 · التحليل بالتوازي",
                        "text": f"{len(SPECIALISTS)} متخصصين × {len(cands)} أسواق شغالين في نفس الوقت."})

- **مراجعة الستوب:** دالة `Journal.postmortem` في [modules/ws/14_journal_chain.js](modules/ws/14_journal_chain.js:64) بتطلع لكل صفقة ضربت ستوب: التحذيرات اللي كانت شغالة وقت الدخول (الأوردر فلو، الأخبار، التمويل، الـOI، السكور الضعيف)، ولو ستوب أوسع كان هيوصل للهدف، وخطوة واحدة للمرة الجاية. الجدول بيعرض آخر 5 صفقات ستوب تحت الجورنال في [modules/ws/22_panels.js](modules/ws/22_panels.js:1158).
- **النصوص المصرية:** اتغيرت النصوص في صندوق الهارمونيك، والتيكلاس، والديسك، والأوردر فلو، والجورنال، وبعض الـi18n. لسه فيه نصوص مصرية في الـguide، و`24_flow_confluence_misc.js`، و`arabic.py`، و`26_snap.js`.
- **صندوق الصفقة:** من الخطوة اللي فاتت، الصفقة المفتوحة في الجورنال بتتعرض كشغالة مش "انتظار".

**الاختبارات:** `workspace_app.html` اتبنى تاني، واختبارات الـworkspace الثلاثة نجحت، وسكريبتات الـHTML مرت من `node --check`.

**لسه ناقص:**
- التحقق في المتصفح (الشارت، صندوق الصفقة، مراجعة الستوب).
- مراجعة التابات الثلاثة (أسواق، صفقات، تشارتس) بالكامل.
- تحويل كل النصوص المصرية في كل الملفات.

التعديلات موجودة في ملفات مش متعمل لها commit.

 "content": "\"\"\"THE trade journal: one server-side store for every trade the workspace logs (replaces the per-browser localStorage copy).\n\nWhy: a browser's localStorage is per browser, lost when site data is cleared, and invisible to the brain. This file is the\nsingle source of truth; the brain (modules/brain.py) and the meeting-room table read it from here.\n\nRecord (dict, key = [REDACTED]  id, key, symbol, dir (\"bullish\" | \"bearish\"), tfk, ttype, entry, sl, tp1, tp2, tp3, rr, score, max, tags, t0 (ms),\n  status: \"open\" | \"part\" (tp1 hit, runner still open) | \"tp\" (final target) | \"sl\" | \"nf\" (never filled) | \"exp\" (time ran out),\n  fill: bool, exits: [{level: \"tp1\"|\"tp2\"|\"tp3\"|\"sl\", t, price, r}], ctx: dict (context at entry), reason: str, notes: str\n\nRules (kept from the JS journal): a trade that never filled is \"nf\", not a loss. Same candle touches stop and target: stop counts.\nCosts are not included. Under 30 closed trades nothing here is evidence.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport time\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"TRADE_JOURNAL_PATH\", \"data/journal/trades.json\"))\nMIN_N = 30\nFINAL = {\"tp\", \"sl\", \"nf\", \"exp\"}\nLEVELS = (\"tp1\", \"tp2\", \"tp3\")\n\n\ndef _load(path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    p = path or PATH\n    if not p.exists():\n        return {}\n    try:\n        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):\n        return {}\n\n\ndef _save(data: dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    p = path or PATH\n    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    tmp = p.with_suffix(\".tmp\")\n    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    os.replace(tmp, p)  # atomic: a crash never leaves a half-written journal\n\n\ndef _num(v, name: str) -> float:\n    if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or v != v:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{name} must be a finite number\")\n    return float(v)\n\n\ndef upsert(rec: dict, path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Add a trade (or refresh its entry fields). Exits and final status of an existing trade are never overwritten here.\"\"\"\n    tid = str(rec.get(\"id\") or \"\")\n    if not tid:\n        raise ValueError(\"id required\")\n    if rec.get(\"dir\") not in (\"bullish\", \"bearish\"):\n        raise ValueError(\"dir must be bullish or bearish\")\n    for k in (\"entry\", \"sl\", \"tp1\"):\n        _num(rec.get(k), k)\n    data = _load(path)\n    cur = data.get(tid, {\"exits\": [], \"status\": \"open\", \"fill\": rec.get(\"fill\", True)})\n    for k, v in rec.items():\n        if k not in (\"exits\", \"status\"):\n            cur[k] = v\n    cur[\"id\"] = tid\n    cur.setdefault(\"t0\", int(time.time() * 1000))\n    data[tid] = cur\n    _save(data, path)\n    return cur\n\n\ndef add_exit(tid: str, level: str, t: int, price: float, r: float, path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Record one exit. tp1 leaves the trade \"part\" (runner still open); tp2 / tp3 / sl / nf / exp end it.\"\"\"\n    if level not in (\"sl\", *LEVELS):\n        raise ValueError(\"level must be sl, tp1, tp2 or tp3\")\n    data = _load(path)\n    tr = data.get(tid)\n    if tr is None:\n        raise KeyError(tid)\n    if tr[\"status\"] in FINAL:\n        return tr  # already finished: a repeated tracker run does not double-count\n    tr[\"exits\"].append({\"level\": level, \"t\": int(t), \"price\": _num(price, \"price\"), \"r\": _num(r, \"r\")})\n    if level == \"sl\":\n        tr[\"status\"] = \"sl\"\n    elif level == \"tp3\" or (level == \"tp2\" and not tr.get(\"tp3\")):\n        tr[\"status\"] = \"tp\"\n    elif level == \"tp1\":\n        tr[\"status\"] = \"part\" if tr.get(\"tp2\") else \"tp\"\n    _save(data, path)\n    return tr\n\n\ndef finish(tid: str, status: str, t: int, r: float, reason: str = \"\", path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Close a trade that did not exit through a level (nf / exp), or attach the reason to a closed one.\"\"\"\n    if status not in FINAL:\n        raise ValueError(\"status must be tp, sl, nf or exp\")\n    data = _load(path)\n    tr = data.get(tid)\n    if tr is None:\n        raise KeyError(tid)\n    if tr[\"status\"] not in FINAL:\n        tr[\"status\"] = status\n        tr[\"t1\"] = int(t)\n        tr[\"r_total\"] = _num(r, \"r\")\n    if reason:\n        tr[\"reason\"] = str(reason)[:2000]\n    _save(data, path)\n    return tr\n\n\ndef r_total(tr: dict) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Sum of exit R. Exits are per trade-unit: a partial tp1 counts its own R, the runner counts its own.\"\"\"\n    if tr.get(\"status\") not in FINAL and tr.get(\"status\") != \"part\":\n        return 0.0\n    if tr.get(\"exits\"):\n        return sum(e[\"r\"] for e in tr[\"exits\"])\n    return float(tr.get(\"r_total\") or 0.0)\n\n\ndef postmortem(tr: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Why a stopped (or partly stopped) trade lost, what was already against it at entry, and the next step. Pure.\"\"\"\n    long_ = tr.get(\"dir\") == \"bullish\"\n    ctx = tr.get(\"ctx\") or {}\n    why: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []  # (text, is_warning)\n    if ctx.get(\"of\") == \"against\":\n        why.append((\"order flow was against the trade at entry\", True))\n    if ctx.get(\"news\"):\n        why.append((\"news was active on the symbol at entry\", True))\n    if ctx.get(\"fund\") == (\"crowded longs\" if long_ else \"crowded shorts\"):\n        why.append((\"funding was crowded on the trade side\", True))\n    if ctx.get(\"oi\") in ((\"shorts\", \"closing\") if long_ else (\"longs\", \"cover\")):\n        why.append((\"open interest did not back the trade\", True))\n    if tr.get(\"score\") is not None and tr.get(\"max\") and 100 * tr[\"score\"] / tr[\"max\"] < 70:\n        why.append((\"setup score was weak (under 70%)\", True))\n    exits = {e[\"level\"] for e in tr.get(\"exits\", [])}\n    if \"sl\" in exits and \"tp1\" in exits:\n        why.append((\"tp1 hit, then the runner was stopped: the trailing rule gave back the profit\", False))\n    if tr.get(\"mfe_r\") is not None and \"sl\" in exits and tr[\"mfe_r\"] < 1:\n        why.append((\"price never moved 1R in favour: entry was early\", False))\n    warns = sum(1 for _, w in why if w)\n    if warns:\n        nxt = f\"skip or wait: {warns} warning(s) were already on at entry\"\n    elif \"tp1\" in exits and \"sl\" in exits:\n        nxt = \"exit runner earlier at tp1 or move stop to entry after tp1\"\n    elif \"sl\" in exits:\n        nxt = \"entry came early: wait for a confirming close before entering\"\n    else:\n        nxt = \"no stop: nothing to review\"\n    if not why:\n        why.append((\"no warning was recorded at entry\", False))\n    return {\"why\": [t for t, _ in why], \"next\": nxt, \"warnings\": warns}\n\n\ndef stats(path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Win rate and average R per setup type and per timeframe, closed trades only. n < MIN_N is marked not evidence.\"\"\"\n    closed = [t for t in _load(path).values() if t.get(\"status\") in (\"tp\", \"sl\", \"exp\", \"part\")]\n    out: dict = {\"n\": len(closed), \"evidence\": len(closed) >= MIN_N, \"groups\": {}}\n    groups: dict = defaultdict(list)\n    for t in closed:\n        groups[(\"ttype\", t.get(\"ttype\"))].append(t)\n        groups[(\"tfk\", t.get(\"tfk\"))].append(t)\n    for (kind, name), ts in groups.items():\n        rs = [r_total(t) for t in ts]\n        out[\"groups\"].setdefault(kind, {})[str(name)] = {\n            \"n\": len(ts), \"win_pct\": round(100 * sum(1 for r in rs if r > 0) / len(rs), 1), \"avg_r\": round(sum(rs) / len(rs), 3),\n            \"evidence\": len(ts) >= MIN_N}\n    return out\n\n\ndef all_trades(path: Path | None = None) -> list:\n    return sorted(_load(path).values(), key=[REDACTED] t: t.get(\"t0\", 0), reverse=True)\n"

- [modules/trade_journal.py](modules/trade_journal.py): مخزن واحد على السيرفر في `data/journal/trades.json`. بيتعامل مع tp1 وtp2 وtp3 وstop ويفصل بين الصفقة اللي ماتنفذتش والصفقة الخاسرة. فيه مراجعة للصفقة بتقول ليه خسرت وإيه اللي كان المفروض يحصل، وإحصائيات بتقول "ليس دليلًا" لو العينة أقل من 30.
- [tests/test_trade_journal.py](tests/test_trade_journal.py): الاختبارات عدّت كلها، وتشمل الرفض لو البيانات غلط، وحفظ ذري، وسبب الخروج، وسقف 2000 حرف.

**اللي لسه ما اتعملش:**
- الجورنال في المتصفح لسه بيتخزن في `localStorage`. الشارت شغال كـ`components.html`، وده ما بيقدرش يكتب على السيرفر.
- لازم نحول الـworkspace لـ`declare_component` زي [modules/guide_ai.py](modules/guide_ai.py)، عشان يبعت كل حدث صفقة لبايثون.
- المحرك لسه ما بيقرأ الجورنال الجديد.
- لسه ما شفتش مراجعة الصفقات اللي ضربت ستوب في الجورنال الجديد.
- الصور اللي قلت إن جروك رفعها مش موجودة في الريبو. فيه بس 5 SVG في `docs/img/setups/`، وده محتاج منك إعادة رفع أو مسار الملفات.
- هدف 60% نسبة نجاح مش مضمون. النسبة دي لازم تطلع من صفقات مقفولة، وأقل من 30 صفقة مش دليل.

**الملفات اللي اتعدلت:** `modules/trade_journal.py` وملف الاختبار الجديد. مش متعمل لهم commit.

/* XPiX guide bridge (hidden Streamlit component). The workspace frame (same origin) calls window.__xpixBridge.ask({id,q,ctx});

(function(){

  window.addEventListener("message", ev => {

})();

Python stores them in trade_journal and sends back acks {uid: last seq},\n   so an event is dropped from the queue only once it is saved. Events are re-sent until acked (nothing is lost on a rerun). */\n(function(){\n  const send = (type, extra) => window.parent.postMessage(Object.assign({isStreamlitMessage:true, type}, extra || {}), \"*\");\n  const uid = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36);\n  let seq = 0, queue = [], acks = {}, lastSent = \"\";\n  function flush(){\n    const body = JSON.stringify({uid, events: queue});\n    if (body === lastSent) return; lastSent = body;\n    send(\"streamlit:setComponentValue\", {value:{uid, events: queue}, dataType:\"json\"});\n  }\n  window.__xpixJournal = {\n    push(rec){ if (!rec || !rec.id) return false; queue.push({seq: ++seq, rec}); if (queue.length > 500) queue = queue.slice(-500); flush(); return true; }\n  };\n  window.addEventListener(\"message\", ev => {\n    const d = ev.data || {}; if (d.type !== \"streamlit:render\") return;\n    const a = d.args || {}; const ack = a.acks || {};\n    if (ack[uid] != null){ queue = queue.filter(e => e.seq > ack[uid]); }\n    flush();\n  });\n  send(\"streamlit:componentReady\", {apiVersion:1}); send(\"streamlit:setFrameHeight\", {height:0});\n})();\n</script></body></html>\n"

 "content": "\"\"\"Browser -> server journal sync. The workspace (a static iframe) pushes trade snapshots through the hidden component in\nmodules/journal_bridge/; this module saves them to trade_journal (the one store) and acks them so nothing is lost on a rerun.\n\nIdempotent: a snapshot re-sent after a rerun is merged again with no change. Bad snapshots are dropped, not saved.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\n\nimport streamlit as st\nimport streamlit.components.v1 as components\n\nfrom modules import trade_journal as TJ\n\n_bridge = components.declare_component(\"xpix_journal_bridge\", path=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"journal_bridge\"))\nACKS_KEY = \"journal_acks\"\n\n\ndef sync() -> int:\n    \"\"\"Call once per run on the page that hosts the workspace. Returns how many new snapshots were saved this run.\"\"\"\n    acks: dict = st.session_state.get(ACKS_KEY, {})\n    val = _bridge(key=\"journal_bridge\", default=None, acks=acks)\n    if not isinstance(val, dict):\n        return 0\n    uid = str(val.get(\"uid\") or \"\")\n    events = val.get(\"events\") or []\n    if not uid or not isinstance(events, list):\n        return 0\n    last = int(acks.get(uid, 0))\n    saved = 0\n    for ev in sorted((e for e in events if isinstance(e, dict)), key=[REDACTED] e: int(e.get(\"seq\") or 0)):\n        seq = int(ev.get(\"seq\") or 0)\n        rec = ev.get(\"rec\")\n        if seq <= last or not isinstance(rec, dict):\n            continue\n        try:\n            TJ.apply_snapshot(rec)\n            saved += 1\n        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):\n            pass  # a bad snapshot is dropped (it would fail the same way on every resend)\n        last = seq\n    acks[uid] = last\n    st.session_state[ACKS_KEY] = acks\n    return saved\n"
}

A factor becomes a lesson only with n >= MIN_N and a clear gap vs the baseline. Lessons are\nwritten as CANDIDATES: nothing changes the live scanner by itself; a candidate is promoted by a person after review\n(same rule as modules/brain.py). Costs are not included. Times are UTC.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport time\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom modules import trade_journal as TJ\n\nMIN_N = 30\nGAP_PTS = 15.0  # win-rate gap vs baseline (percentage points) before a factor counts as a lesson\nLESSONS = Path(os.environ.get(\"TRADE_LESSONS_PATH\", \"data/journal/lessons.json\"))\n\n\ndef factors(tr: dict) -> list[str]:\n    ctx = tr.get(\"ctx\") or {}\n    out = [f\"setup:{tr.get('ttype')}\", f\"tf:{tr.get('tfk')}\", f\"side:{'long' if tr.get('dir') == 'bullish' else 'short'}\"]\n    s, m = tr.get(\"score\"), tr.get(\"max\")\n    if s is not None and m:\n        pct = 100 * s / m\n        out.append(\"score:<60\" if pct < 60 else \"score:60-79\" if pct < 80 else \"score:80+\")\n    out += [f\"of:{ctx.get('of', 'n/a')}\", f\"news:{'yes' if ctx.get('news') else 'no'}\", f\"fund:{ctx.get('fund') or 'none'}\",\n            f\"oi:{ctx.get('oi') or 'n/a'}\", f\"ses:{ctx.get('ses') or 'n/a'}\"]\n    out += [f\"tag:{t}\" for t in (tr.get(\"tags\") or [])[:4]]\n    return out\n\n\ndef _closed(trades: list) -> list:\n    return [t for t in trades if t.get(\"status\") in (\"tp\", \"sl\", \"exp\")]\n\n\ndef learn(trades: list | None = None, path: Path | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Factor table + lesson candidates. Pass trades (dicts) or let it read the journal.\"\"\"\n    trades = trades if trades is not None else TJ.all_trades(path)\n    closed = _closed(trades)\n    n = len(closed)\n    base_rs = [TJ.r_total(t) for t in closed]\n    base_win = 100 * sum(1 for r in base_rs if r > 0) / n if n else 0.0\n    groups: dict = defaultdict(list)\n    for t in closed:\n        for f in factors(t):\n            groups[f].append(t)\n    table = []\n    for f, ts in sorted(groups.items()):\n        rs = [TJ.r_total(t) for t in ts]\n        win = 100 * sum(1 for r in rs if r > 0) / len(rs)\n        gap = win - base_win\n        ev = len(ts) >= MIN_N\n        verdict = \"not evidence\" if not ev else \"avoid\" if gap <= -GAP_PTS else \"prefer\" if gap >= GAP_PTS else \"neutral\"\n        table.append({\"factor\": f, \"n\": len(ts), \"win_pct\": round(win, 1), \"avg_r\": round(sum(rs) / len(rs), 3),\n                      \"gap_pts\": round(gap, 1), \"verdict\": verdict})\n    candidates = [{\"status\": \"candidate\", \"rule\": (f\"require confirmation before entry when {r['factor']}\" if r[\"verdict\"] == \"avoid\"\n                                                   else f\"take this setup when {r['factor']}\"),\n                   \"evidence\": f\"n={r['n']}, win {r['win_pct']}% vs baseline {round(base_win, 1)}%, avg R {r['avg_r']}\"}\n                  for r in table if r[\"verdict\"] in (\"avoid\", \"prefer\")]\n    out = {\"ts\": int(time.time()), \"n_closed\": n, \"evidence\": n >= MIN_N, \"baseline_win_pct\": round(base_win, 1),\n           \"table\": table, \"candidates\": candidates}\n    return out\n\n\ndef save_lessons(result: dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write the lessons file (replaces the previous one). Read by the journal panel; never read by the scanner.\"\"\"\n    p = path or LESSONS\n    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    tmp = p.with_suffix(\".tmp\")\n    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    os.replace(tmp, p)\n\n\ndef trade_table(trades: list | None = None, path: Path | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Markdown table: one row per closed trade, with the reason it won or lost. For the meeting room.\"\"\"\n    trades = trades if trades is not None else TJ.all_trades(path)\n    rows = [\"| UTC set | Symbol | Setup | TF | Side | Result | R | Why | Next time |\", \"|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\"]\n    for t in _closed(trades):\n        a = TJ.analyze(t)\n        why = \"; \".join(a[\"postmortem\"][\"why\"]) if a[\"postmortem\"] else \"won: \" + \", \".join(e[\"level\"] for e in a[\"exits\"])\n        nxt = a[\"postmortem\"][\"next\"] if a[\"postmortem\"] else \"keep the same rule\"\n        rows.append(f\"| {a['set_utc']} | {a['symbol']} | {a['setup']} | {a['tf']} | {a['side']} | {a['status']} | {a['r_total']} | {why} | {nxt} |\")\n    return \"\\n\".join(rows)\n"
}

Synthetic trades only.\nPlain script: python3 tests/test_trade_learning.py\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\"))\nfrom modules import trade_learning as L  # noqa: E402\nfrom modules import trade_journal as TJ  # noqa: E402\n\ntmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())\n\n\ndef mk(i, win, against):\n    tr = {\"id\": f\"t{i}\", \"symbol\": \"XAUUSD\", \"dir\": \"bullish\", \"tfk\": \"1h\", \"ttype\": \"bounce\", \"entry\": 100.0, \"sl\": 99.0,\n          \"tp1\": 101.0, \"score\": 8, \"max\": 10, \"t0\": 1_800_000_000_000 + i * 3600_000, \"fill\": True,\n          \"ctx\": {\"of\": \"against\" if against else \"agree\", \"news\": False, \"fund\": None, \"oi\": None, \"ses\": \"NY AM KZ\"},\n          \"tags\": [\"bounce\"], \"exits\": []}\n    if win:\n        tr[\"exits\"] = [{\"level\": \"tp1\", \"t\": tr[\"t0\"] + 1000, \"price\": 101.0, \"r\": 1.0}]\n        tr[\"status\"] = \"tp\"\n    else:\n        tr[\"exits\"] = [{\"level\": \"sl\", \"t\": tr[\"t0\"] + 1000, \"price\": 99.0, \"r\": -1.0}]\n        tr[\"status\"] = \"sl\"\n    return tr\n\n\n# 40 closed trades: \"against\" order flow loses, \"agree\" wins 3 of 4\ntrades = []\nfor i in range(40):\n    against = i % 2 == 0\n    win = (not against) and (i % 4 != 1)  # agree: 3 of 4 win ; against: all lose\n    trades.append(mk(i, win, against))\nres = L.learn(trades)\nassert res[\"evidence\"] is True and res[\"n_closed\"] == 40, res\nrow = {r[\"factor\"]: r for r in res[\"table\"]}\nassert row[\"of:against\"][\"verdict\"] == \"avoid\" and row[\"of:agree\"][\"verdict\"] == \"prefer\", row\nassert any(\"require confirmation\" in c[\"rule\"] and \"of:against\" in c[\"rule\"] for c in res[\"candidates\"]), res[\"candidates\"]\nassert all(c[\"status\"] == \"candidate\" for c in res[\"candidates\"])\nprint(\"ok learn avoid/prefer:\", row[\"of:against\"][\"win_pct\"], \"vs\", row[\"of:agree\"][\"win_pct\"])\n\n# under 30 trades: everything is \"not evidence\", no candidates\nsmall = L.learn(trades[:10])\nassert small[\"evidence\"] is False and all(r[\"verdict\"] == \"not evidence\" for r in small[\"table\"]) and small[\"candidates\"] == []\nprint(\"ok evidence gate\")\n\n# save and read lessons file\np = tmp / \"lessons.json\"\nL.save_lessons(res, p)\nassert p.exists() and \"table\" in __import__(\"json\").loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nprint(\"ok lessons saved\")\n\n# trade table: one row per closed trade plus header\ntbl = L.trade_table(trades[:3])\nassert tbl.count(\"\\n\") == 4 and \"| UTC set |\" in tbl, tbl\nprint(\"ok trade table rows:\", tbl.count(\"\\n\") - 1)\nprint(\"ALL OK\")\n"
}

    """Short git commit of the running code ('' when it cannot be read): shown in the Workspace bar so the owner can see at once which build is live (after a merge the app needs a few minutes + a Rebo
    import re

        v = r.stdout.strip()
        if r.returncode == 0 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{6,40}", v):
            return v

def _ws_html_reuse(fp, scanning: bool):
    """Last iframe HTML if it is still good to show, else None (= build a fresh one). Same string = no iframe reload."""
    import streamlit as st
    last = st.session_state.get("ws_html_sent")
    if not last or last[0] != fp:
        return None
    age = time.time() - last[2]
    if age < WS_HTML_REFRESH_SECS or (scanning and age < WS_HTML_MAX_SECS):
        return last[1]
    return None

_TPL_CACHE: dict = {}


def _template_text() -> str:
    """The 1.15 MB template was re-read from disk on every Streamlit rerun; cache it, reload only when the file changes."""
    mt = _TEMPLATE.stat().st_mtime_ns
    if _TPL_CACHE.get("mt") != mt:
        _TPL_CACHE["mt"] = mt
        _TPL_CACHE["text"] = _TEMPLATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return _TPL_CACHE["text"]


def seed_from_df(symbol: str, tf: str, df, bars: int = 200) -> dict | None:
    """Snapshot of recent candles (from the server side) shown only if the
    browser cannot reach OKX directly, so the chart is never blank."""
    try:
        d = df.iloc[:-1].tail(bars)  # drop the forming candle so the page HTML stays stable between refreshes
        rows = [[int(t.timestamp() * 1000), float(o), float(h), float(l), float(c), float(v)]
                for t, o, h, l, c, v in zip(d["time"], d["open"], d["high"], d["low"], d["close"], d["volume"])]
        return {"sym": symbol, "tf": {"1h": "1H", "1d": "1D", "1w": "1W"}.get(tf, tf), "rows": rows}
    except Exception:
        return None


                     asset_cls: str = "Crypto", meme: list | None = None, world: list | None = None, tfstats: dict | None = None, cmc: dict | None = None, macrof: dict | None = None, stockf: dict | None = None, world_errs: list | None = None, yf: dict | None = None, cal: list | None = None, ui_theme: str = "", ui_bg: str = "", ui_mat: str = ""):
    import streamlit.components.v1 as components

    # The page data is baked into the iframe HTML, so any change to it reloads the iframe (the blink). Reuse the last HTML
    # while the layout is the same and the data is fresh enough; the browser keeps its own live feeds in the meantime.
    # the template's mtime is part of the key: a new build (UI change) is shown at once, not after the 3-10 min reuse window
    fp = (tuple(symbols), lang, asset_cls, ui_theme, ui_bg, ui_mat, height, _TEMPLATE.stat().st_mtime_ns)
    doc = _ws_html_reuse(fp, scanning)
    if doc is None:
        doc = build_workspace_html(symbols, news, lang, alerts=alerts, seed=seed, scan=scan, links=links, filters=filters, ready=ready, smt=smt, scanning=scanning, asset_cls=asset_cls, meme=meme, world=world, tfstats=tfstats, cmc=cmc, macrof=macrof, stockf=stockf, world_errs=world_errs, yf=yf, fh_token=[REDACTED], cal=cal, ui_theme=ui_theme, ui_bg=ui_bg, ui_mat=ui_mat)
        import streamlit as st
        st.session_state["ws_html_sent"] = (fp, doc, time.time())
    components.html(doc, height=height, scrolling=False)


WS_HTML_REFRESH_SECS = 180   # send new page data at most this often (when the scan is idle)
WS_HTML_MAX_SECS = 600       # ...and never keep data older than this, even while a scan is still running


def _ws_html_reuse(fp, scanning: bool):
    """Last iframe HTML if it is still good to show, else None (= build a fresh one). Same string = no iframe reload."""
    import streamlit as st
    last = st.session_state.get("ws_html_sent")
    if not last or last[0] != fp:
        return None
    age = time.time() - last[2]
    if age < WS_HTML_REFRESH_SECS or (scanning and age < WS_HTML_MAX_SECS):
        return last[1]
    return None

  resize(){
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1, hw = this.host.clientWidth, hh = this.host.clientHeight; this.S = CHART_S;
    this.W = hw/this.S; this.H = hh/this.S;   // the chart is laid out in its own units: at 50 % zoom it has twice the room, so more candles fit
    const cw_ = Math.round(this.W*dpr), ch_ = Math.round(this.H*dpr); if (this.cv.width !== cw_) this.cv.width = cw_; if (this.cv.height !== ch_) this.cv.height = ch_;   // assigning width/height clears the canvas even when the value is the same
    this.cv.style.width = hw+"px"; this.cv.style.height = hh+"px";
    this.ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); this.paint();   // paint NOW, not draw(): ResizeObserver runs after the frame's rAF callbacks, so a rAF-deferred repaint leaves one blank canvas frame on screen = the blink
  }
  setData(arr, fit){
    this.data = arr; this.calcEma();
    if (fit){ const sv = this.viewGet(); this.fit(); if (sv && arr.length > 3 && sv.bw){ this.restoreFrom(sv); this.r = arr.length-1 + Math.round(0.5*this.PR/this.bw); this.clampR(); this.saveView(); /* open always centers the latest candle; saved zoom and price scale are kept */ const lc = arr[arr.length-1].c; if (this.lockR && (lc < this.lockR[0] || lc > this.lockR[1])) this.lockR = null; /* on open only: a saved lock that does not even contain the latest price (taken on stale cached candles) is re-fitted once */ this.draw(); } }   // fit() overwrote the saved view with the default: put back what was saved (zoom, position, price scale) so a reload opens exactly where it was left
    else this.draw();   // 2026-11-09 owner: no auto-follow and no automatic reset of the price scale: the chart moves only when you move it
  }
  restoreFrom(v){ this.lockR = v.lk || null; this.bw = v.bw || this.bw; this.yZoom = v.yZoom || 1; this.yShift = v.yShift || 0; this.r = (this.data.length-1) - v.back; this.clampR(); this.saveView(); }
  calcEma(){
    this.emaV = {};
    const emaOf = (arr, len) => { const k = 2/(len+1); let e = null; return arr.map(v => (e = e == null ? v : v*k + e*(1-k))); };

def school_weights(entries, graded: dict, min_n: int = 10, shrink_n: int = 20, lo: float = 0.7, hi: float = 1.3) -> dict:
    """EXPERIMENTAL score multiplier per school from its graded average R: mult = 1 + k * avg_r where k = n / (n + shrink_n) shrinks small samples toward 1.0, clamped to [lo, hi].
    Only schools with n >= min_n get a weight (others stay 1.0). Under n = 30 this is NOT evidence, it is a gentle nudge to the ranking only; it never touches the scanner, stars or the lab.
    Switch off with BRAIN_ADAPT=0."""
    if os.environ.get("BRAIN_ADAPT", "1") == "0":
        return {}
    out = {}
    for name, r in stats(entries, graded)["school"].items():
        n = r["n"]
        if n < min_n:
            continue
        k = n / (n + shrink_n)
        out[name] = round(max(lo, min(hi, 1.0 + k * r["avg_r"])), 3)
    return out
```

def review_text(entries, graded: dict, day: str | None = None, ar: bool = True, agents: str = "") -> str:
    """The daily review message: how the last graded ideas did, per school, with the n<30 warning."""
    import html
    esc = html.escape
    st = stats(entries, graded)
    a = st["all"]
    if not a["n"]:
        return ("🧠 <b>مراجعة المخ</b>\nلسه مفيش أفكار اتقيّمت (بتتقيّم بعد 6 ساعات على الأقل)." if ar else "🧠 <b>Brain review</b>\nNo idea has been graded yet (they are graded 6 h or more after the list).")
    lines = [f"🧠 <b>{'مراجعة المخ' if ar else 'Brain review'}</b> · {a['n']} {'فكرة متقيّمة' if ar else 'graded ideas'} · {'متوسط' if ar else 'avg'} {a['avg_r']:+.2f}R · {a['win']}% {'رابحة' if ar else 'wins'}"]
    rows = sorted(st["school"].items(), key=[REDACTED] kv: -kv[1]["n"])[:6]
    for name, r in rows:
        lines.append(f"• {esc(name)}: n={r['n']} · {r['avg_r']:+.2f}R · {r['win']}%" + ("" if r["evidence"] else (" · ⚠ مش دليل (n<30)" if ar else " · ⚠ not evidence (n<30)")))
    if agents:
        lines.append("\n" + agents)
    lines.append("\n<i>R قبل التكاليف. المخ بيسجّل ويقيّم ويقترح بس؛ أي ترقية بتعدي على اللاب الأسبوعي.</i>" if ar else "\n<i>R before costs. The brain logs, grades and suggests only; any promotion goes through the weekly lab.</i>")
    return "\n".join(lines)[:3900]

  async track(){
    if (this.busy) return; const open = this.list.filter(t => t.status === "open"); if (!open.length) return; this.busy = true; let changed = false;
    try {
      const bySym = {}; open.forEach(t => (bySym[t.symbol] = bySym[t.symbol] || []).push(t));
      for (const sym of Object.keys(bySym)){
        const trs = bySym[sym], oldest = Math.min(...trs.map(t => t.t0)), age = Date.now() - oldest, bar = age < 4.5*3600e3 ? JBAR["1m"] : age < 12*86400e3 ? JBAR["1H"] : JBAR["1D"];
        let rows; try { rows = (await okx("/market/candles?instId="+encodeURIComponent(sym)+"&bar="+bar[0]+"&limit=300")).map(r => ({t:+r[0], h:+r[2], l:+r[3], c:+r[4]})).reverse(); } catch(e){ continue; }
        trs.forEach(tr => {
          const long_ = tr.dir === "bullish"; if (rows.length){ tr.last = rows[rows.length-1].c; changed = true; }
          for (const c of rows){
            if (c.t + bar[1] <= tr.t0) continue;
            let fc = false;   // fill candle: the target in the same candle could have printed BEFORE the fill, so only the stop counts there
            if (tr.fill === false){   // entry not touched yet: a move to the stop or the target WITHOUT touching the entry was never a trade
              if (c.l <= tr.entry && tr.entry <= c.h){ tr.fill = true; fc = true; changed = true; }
              else { const away = long_ ? (c.l > tr.entry ? c.h >= tr.tp1 : c.h < tr.entry && c.l <= tr.sl) : (c.h < tr.entry ? c.l <= tr.tp1 : c.l > tr.entry && c.h >= tr.sl); if (away){ tr.status = "nf"; tr.r = 0; tr.t1 = c.t + bar[1]; changed = true; break; } continue; } }
            const sl = long_ ? c.l <= tr.sl : c.h >= tr.sl, tp = !fc && (long_ ? c.h >= tr.tp1 : c.l <= tr.tp1);
            if (sl){ tr.status = "sl"; tr.r = -1; tr.t1 = c.t + bar[1]; changed = true; break; }   // same candle touches both: count the stop (conservative)
            if (tp){ tr.status = "tp"; tr.r = tr.rr; tr.t1 = c.t + bar[1]; changed = true; break; }
          }
          if (tr.status === "open" && Date.now() - tr.t0 > (JEXP[tr.tfk] || 3*86400e3)){ tr.status = tr.fill === false ? "nf" : "exp"; tr.r = 0; tr.t1 = Date.now(); changed = true; }
        });
      }
    } finally { this.busy = false; }

def add_exit(tid: str, level: str, t: int, price: float, r: float, path: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Record one exit. tp1 leaves the trade "part" (runner still open); tp2 / tp3 / sl / nf / exp end it."""
    if level not in ("sl", *LEVELS):
        raise ValueError("level must be sl, tp1, tp2 or tp3")
    data = _load(path)
    tr = data.get(tid)
    if tr is None:
        raise KeyError(tid)
    if tr["status"] in FINAL or any(e["level"] == level for e in tr["exits"]):
        return tr  # already finished or this level already booked: a repeated tracker run does not double-count
    tr["exits"].append({"level": level, "t": int(t), "price": _num(price, "price"), "r": _num(r, "r")})
    if level == "sl":
        tr["status"] = "sl"
    elif level == "tp3" or (level == "tp2" and not tr.get("tp3")):
        tr["status"] = "tp"
    elif level == "tp1":
        tr["status"] = "part" if tr.get("tp2") else "tp"
    _save(data, path)
    return tr


def apply_snapshot(snap: dict, path: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Merge one browser snapshot (the JS journal record after a change). Idempotent: re-sending the same snapshot changes nothing."""
    data = _load(path)
    tr = _merge(data, snap)
    _save(data, path)
    return tr


def apply_snapshots(snaps: list, path: Path | None = None) -> int:
    """Merge many snapshots with ONE read and ONE write. A bad snapshot is skipped. Returns how many were merged."""
    data = _load(path)
    n = 0
    for s in snaps:
        try:
            _merge(data, s)
            n += 1
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            continue
    if n:
        _save(data, path)
    return n


def _merge(data: dict, snap: dict) -> dict:
    """Status only moves forward: a final status (tp / sl / nf / exp) is never overwritten by a later snapshot."""
    tid = str(snap.get("id") or "")
    if not tid:
        raise ValueError("id required")
    if tid not in data:
        if snap.get("dir") not in ("bullish", "bearish"):
            raise ValueError("dir must be bullish or bearish")
        for k in ("entry", "sl", "tp1"):
            _num(snap.get(k), k)
        data[tid] = {"id": tid, "exits": [], "status": "open", "fill": True, "t0": int(snap.get("t0") or time.time() * 1000)}
    tr = data[tid]
    for k in ("symbol", "dir", "tfk", "ttype", "entry", "sl", "tp1", "tp2", "tp3", "rr", "score", "max", "tags", "ctx", "fill"):
        if k in snap and snap[k] is not None:
            tr[k] = snap[k]
    if tr["status"] not in FINAL and snap.get("status") in FINAL:
        tr["status"] = snap["status"]
        tr["r_total"] = _num(snap.get("r") or 0.0, "r")
        tr["t1"] = int(snap.get("t1") or 0)
        if snap.get("status") == "sl" and not any(e["level"] == "sl" for e in tr["exits"]):
            tr["exits"].append({"level": "sl", "t": tr["t1"], "price": _num(tr.get("sl"), "sl"), "r": tr["r_total"]})
    if snap.get("reason"):
        tr["reason"] = str(snap["reason"])[:2000]
    return tr



def r_total(tr: dict) -> float:
    """Sum of exit R. Exits are per trade-unit: a partial tp1 counts its own R, the runner counts its own."""
    if tr.get("status") not in FINAL and tr.get("status") != "part":
        return 0.0
    if tr.get("exits"):
        return sum(e["r"] for e in tr["exits"])
    return float(tr.get("r_total") or 0.0)
```

def _merge(data: dict, snap: dict) -> dict:
    """Status only moves forward: a final status (tp / sl / nf / exp) is never overwritten by a later snapshot."""
    tid = str(snap.get("id") or "")
    if not tid:
        raise ValueError("id required")
    if tid not in data:
        if snap.get("dir") not in ("bullish", "bearish"):
            raise ValueError("dir must be bullish or bearish")
        for k in ("entry", "sl", "tp1"):
            _num(snap.get(k), k)
        data[tid] = {"id": tid, "exits": [], "status": "open", "fill": True, "t0": int(snap.get("t0") or time.time() * 1000)}
    tr = data[tid]
    for k in ("symbol", "dir", "tfk", "ttype", "entry", "sl", "tp1", "tp2", "tp3", "rr", "score", "max", "tags", "ctx", "fill"):
        if k in snap and snap[k] is not None:
            tr[k] = snap[k]
    for e in snap.get("exits") or []:   # partial exits from the browser: one per level, booked once
        lvl = e.get("level") if isinstance(e, dict) else None
        if lvl not in ("sl", *LEVELS) or any(x["level"] == lvl for x in tr["exits"]):
            continue
        tr["exits"].append({"level": lvl, "t": int(e.get("t") or 0), "price": _num(e.get("price", 0.0), "price"), "r": _num(e.get("r", 0.0), "r")})
    if tr["status"] == "open" and any(x["level"] in LEVELS for x in tr["exits"]):
        tr["status"] = "part"   # a target was hit, the runner is still open
    if tr["status"] not in FINAL and snap.get("status") in FINAL:
        tr["status"] = snap["status"]
        tr["r_total"] = _num(snap.get("r") or 0.0, "r")
        tr["t1"] = int(snap.get("t1") or 0)
        if snap.get("status") == "sl" and not any(e["level"] == "sl" for e in tr["exits"]):
            tr["exits"].append({"level": "sl", "t": tr["t1"], "price": _num(tr.get("sl"), "sl"), "r": tr["r_total"]})
    if snap.get("reason"):
        tr["reason"] = str(snap["reason"])[:2000]
    return tr


def finish(tid: str, status: str, t: int, r: float, reason: str = "", path: Path | None = None) -> dict:

Partial exits اتعملت. Tests بتعدي، بس منطق الـJS ما اتجربش على شموع حقيقية.

**القاعدة:**
- عدد الأهداف `n` = 1 أو 2 أو 3 حسب المتوفر.
- كل هدف يسجل `1/n` من الصفقة بـR بتاعه عند الوصول. TP1 مثلاً = `|tp1-entry|/risk / n`.
- الصفقة تفضل `open` لحد آخر جزء. بعد TP1 بتتحول لـ`part` في الجورنال بايثون.
- الستوب يسجل الأجزاء المفتوحة بـ`-1R` لكل جزء. مثلاً TP1 ثم ستوب = `1/3 - 2/3 = -1/3R`.
- الانتهاء بالوقت بيحتفظ بالـR اللي اتحقق، والـ`nf` يفضل 0.

**التغييرات:**
- [modules/ws/14_journal_chain.js](modules/ws/14_journal_chain.js): `track()` بيكتب `tr.exits`، وبيبعت `exits` للـpush.
- [modules/trade_journal.py](modules/trade_journal.py) `_merge`: بيستقبل `exits` مرة لكل مستوى، ويحول الحالة لـ`part`.
- [tests/test_trade_journal.py](tests/test_trade_journal.py): تجربة جديدة لـTP1 ثم ستوب، وTP1 وTP2 وTP3 ✅.

**التحقق:**
- `test_trade_journal` و`test_trade_learning` عدّوا.
- `test_workspace_parts_sync` عدّى بعد rebuild.
- `node --check` عدّى على السكريبت المدمج.
- ما اتعملش اختبار للـtrack على شموع حقيقية. الأسعار محجوبة في الـsandbox.

**مش متعمل:** ما اتعملش commit. فيه قرار مفتوح: الستوب بعد TP1 بيفضل على السعر الأصلي، من غير ما ينقل لـbreakeven. لو عايز breakeven قولي.

The search turned up mostly vendor-authored or affiliate content, so treat the comparisons as directional rather than neutral.

**Coinglass (liquidation and positioning focus)**
- Coinglass's liquidity heatmap is described as a color-coded view of market order data, and its own page says the signals can be distorted by orders being cancelled or spoofed. (4-3, 4-4)
- Its liquidation heatmap estimates where future liquidations may occur, based on open interest and leverage distribution. (8-3)
- Liquidation data refreshes every few minutes, which suits intraday monitoring but is not tick-level. (8-4)
- Its liquidation dominance and funding-rate views sit alongside the heatmap. (8-5)
- One reviewer says Coinglass's liquidity heatmap is the view order-flow traders know from Bookmap, which suggests a stylistic resemblance. (7-2)

**Bookmap (order book and execution focus)**
- Bookmap builds a heatmap overlay from the limit order book on major exchanges, covering liquidity depth, buy/sell pressure, and transaction flow. (10-2)
- It shows every limit order's lifespan, and bright bands reveal how long liquidity stayed and whether it was pulled or traded. (15-4, 7-1)
- It combines volume bubbles with real-time and historical liquidity, which is positioned as a hybrid to footprint charts. (5-3, 5-4)
- Trading can happen directly from the heatmap or DOM. (15-5)
- Footprint configurations, volume profiles, and advanced analytics are sold as add-ons, according to a competitor (ATAS). (11-11, 11-12)

**Footprint charts**
- A footprint breaks each candle into bid versus ask volume at each price level. (1-5)
- Bookmap is said to simplify combining footprint and cumulative delta by showing depth and aggression in one view. (9-10)

**Liquidation-specific tooling**
- BloFin notes that CoinGlass and Hyblock are the two most widely used liquidation heatmap providers in crypto. (13-2)
- A third-party reviewer says that for deep single-chart order flow, Bookmap leads, while CoinGlass covers the funding, open interest, and liquidation layer. (12-4, 12-1)

**Bottom line:** Bookmap is generally the choice for real-time, single-market order book and execution visualization. Coinglass is the choice for cross-exchange liquidation and positioning context at a coarser refresh rate. Footprint charts are a separate tool category in most workflows. Most of the comparative claims come from Bookmap, ATAS, or aggregator blogs, so verify them against your own trial before committing.

**المنصات بتقدم إيه (مراجع):**
- [TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/features): multi-chart layouts وHeatmap للأسهم وETF، وstock screener، وalerts بـ13 شرط. بعض المزايا مدفوعة.
- [Bookmap](https://bookmap.com/en/features): liquidity heatmap من دفتر الأوامر (عمر كل أمر وهل اتسحب ولا اتنفذ)، وfootprint وvolume profile وتداول من الـheatmap.
- [Coinglass](https://www.coinglass.com/LiquidityHeatmap): liquidation heatmap، وfunding وOI، وتحديث كل دقايق مش tick.

**اللي عندنا (حسب الكلمات في الكود، مش مثبت إنه شغال):** footprint في حوالي 20 ملف، وDOM في 51، وvolume profile في 14، وliquidation في 8، وCVD في 9، وreplay في 5، وscreener في 4، وalerts في 42.

**الخطوة الجاية:** أفتح كل تاب في المتصفح، وأعمل قايمة بالشغال والمكسور والناقص، وبعدين نرتب أهم التحسينات. تحب أبدأ بالفحص، ولا أبدأ التحسين على طول؟

BY_CLASS = {"Forex": FOREX, "Indices": INDICES, "Egypt (EGX)": EGX, "Saudi (Tadawul)": TADAWUL}


def symbols(cls: str) -> list[str]:
    return [PREFIX + s for s in BY_CLASS.get(cls, [])]


def is_yahoo(sym: str) -> bool:
    return isinstance(sym, str) and sym.startswith(PREFIX)


def parse_chart(d: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Yahoo v8 chart JSON -> OHLCV frame (rows with a missing OHLC value are dropped)."""
    res = ((d or {}).get("chart") or {}).get("result") or []
    if not res:
        err = ((d or {}).get("chart") or {}).get("error") or {}
        raise ValueError(err.get("description") or "no data")
    r = res[0]
    ts, q = r.get("timestamp") or [], ((r.get("indicators") or {}).get("quote") or [{}])[0]
    if not ts or not q.get("close"):
        raise ValueError("no candles")
    df = pd.DataFrame({"time": pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(ts, dtype="int64"), unit="s"), "open": q.get("open"), "high": q.get("high"),
                       "low": q.get("low"), "close": q.get("close"), "volume": q.get("volume") or [0] * len(ts)})
    df = df.dropna(subset=["open", "high", "low", "close"]).copy()
    df["volume"] = df["volume"].fillna(0).astype(float)
    for c in ("open", "high", "low", "close"):
        df[c] = df[c].astype(float)
    return df.reset_index(drop=True)


def get_yahoo_klines(sym: str, tf: str, limit: int = 300) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if tf not in TF:
        raise ValueError(f"Yahoo feed: timeframe {tf} not supported")

def get_yahoo_klines(sym: str, tf: str, limit: int = 300) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if tf not in TF:

    iv, rg, n = TF[tf]

    r = None
    for host in HOSTS:   # second host as a fallback when one is throttled

        except requests.RequestException as e:
            r = None
            err = type(e).__name__
            continue
        if r.status_code == 200:
            break
    if r is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Yahoo unreachable ({err})")
    if r.status_code == 429:
        raise RuntimeError("Yahoo rate limit (429)")
    if r.status_code == 404:
        raise ValueError("Yahoo: unknown symbol")
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Yahoo HTTP {r.status_code}")
    df = parse_chart(r.json())
    if n > 1:

    return df.tail(limit).reset_index(drop=True)

def tv_symbol(sym: str) -> str:
    """"Y:..." -> TradingView symbol for the embedded chart."""
    y = sym[len(PREFIX):]
    if y in _TV:
        return _TV[y]
    if y.endswith("=X"):
        return "FX:" + y[:-2]
    if y.endswith(".CA"):
        return "EGX:" + y[:-3]
    if y.endswith(".SR"):
        return "TADAWUL:" + y[:-3]
    return y


EMBED_TFS = ("15m", "1h", "4h", "1d")


def embed(symbols, bars: int = 200) -> dict:
    """{ "Y:SYM": {"15m": [[ms,o,h,l,c,v], ...oldest first], "1h": ..., "4h": ..., "1d": ...} } for the browser Workspace
    (its page cannot call Yahoo itself - CORS - so the candles are handed over inside the page). Failed symbols are left out."""
    from modules.market_cache import fetch_frames
    ys = [x for x in symbols if is_yahoo(x)]
    if not ys:
        return {}
    frames, _errs = fetch_frames(ys, list(EMBED_TFS), limit=bars, workers=8)
    out = {}
    for sym in ys:
        d = {}
        for tf, df in (frames.get(sym) or {}).items():
            if df is not None and len(df):
                d[tf] = [[int(t.timestamp() * 1000), round(o, 6), round(h, 6), round(l, 6), round(c, 6), round(v, 2)]
                         for t, o, h, l, c, v in zip(df["time"], df["open"], df["high"], df["low"], df["close"], df["volume"])]
        if d:
            out[sym] = d
    return out

# مكتب التداول الذكي (AI Desk) · نموذج أولي

مكتب تحليل ماكرو يعمل على جهازك. يفتح الأدوات أمامك واحدة تلو الأخرى، ويشرح ما يجب أن تنظر إليه في كل أداة، ثم يتدرج من أد�

> **تنبيه:** المكتب لا ينفذ أي صفقة ولا يتصل بأي وسيط. كل فكرة تُسجَّل في دفتر ورقي ويقيّمها المكتب تلقائياً على الأسعار الف�

## التشغيل (5 دقائق)

```bash
cd ai-desk
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
bash scripts/get_vendor.sh       # مكتبة الشارتات (Lightweight Charts، Apache-2.0) مرة واحدة
cp .env.example .env             # وحط مفتاح Gemini المجاني فيه (اختياري)
python -m desk.server            # ثم افتح http://127.0.0.1:8765
```

- للتجربة بدون إنترنت: `DESK_DATA_MODE=demo python -m desk.server`. كل أداة تعمل ببيانات تجريبية تظهر عليها شارة DEMO باللون البرتقالي.
- المسح يعمل تلقائياً كل 15 دقيقة. غيّر المدة بالمتغير `DESK_SCAN_INTERVAL_MIN` (القيمة 0 توقف المسح التلقائي).
- الاختبارات: `DESK_DATA_MODE=demo python -m pytest -q`

## الجديد في 0.8

- **تاب الأبحاث:** Backtest لـ 3 استراتيجيات ليها أدلة منشورة، كل واحدة جنب "اشتري واستنى" على نفس الفترة: Time-series momentum (Moskowitz وآخري
- **تنبيه:** لو Yahoo قافل، Kraken بيدي سنتين بس، فأغلب النتايج هتطلع "مش دليل". مع Yahoo بتبقى 10 سنين.

## الجديد في 0.7.4

- **أسواق جديدة:** نفط WTI (USOIL) وداو جونز (DJI) وراسل 2000 (RUT)، بـ COT بتاعهم. النفط بيكمل من Hyperliquid لو Yahoo قفل، الداو والراسل من Yahoo بس.
- **Wire inspector في نظرة السوق:** كل طلب بيانات بمصدره وسرعته وعدد الشموع أو الخطأ، وسرعة كل مصدر. بيتحدث كل 5 ثواني.
- **ليه مفيش صفقة:** لو كل الأفكار WATCH، سطر واحد فوق الصفقات بأكتر اعتراضين وقفوا الأسواق.
- **مهارات جديدة للوكلاء:** وايكوف (`wyckoff.md`) والشموع اليابانية (`candles.md`).
- **إصلاح:** الـ Correlation كان كله 0.0 لما المصادر تختلط (كل مصدر بيختم الشمعة اليومية في ساعة مختلفة). بقى بيقارن باليوم.

## الجديد في 0.7.3

- **العملات مابقتش تقع على DEMO لما Yahoo يقفل:** Kraken (من غير مفتاح) بيدي 12 زوج حقيقي، والأزواج الناقصة (زي GBPJPY وCADJPY) بتتحسب من أرج�
- **لسه DEMO:** أزواج النيوزيلندي (NZD) السبعة، مفيش لها مصدر مجاني من غير Yahoo.

async function mcBuild() {
  const grid = $("#mc-body"); if (!grid) return;
  mcPanels.forEach(p => { try { p.ch.remove(); } catch (e) {} }); mcPanels = [];
  const syms = mcSymbols(), cols = MC.n <= 4 ? 2 : MC.n <= 9 ? 3 : 4;
  grid.className = "mc mk-grid"; grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols},minmax(0,1fr))`;
  grid.style.setProperty("--mc-h", MC.n <= 4 ? "340px" : MC.n <= 9 ? "250px" : "200px");
  const all = window.UNIVERSE || [];
  grid.innerHTML = syms.map((sym, i) => { const g = MC.groups[i] || ""; return `<div class="mk-cell mc-cell" data-i="${i}" data-g="${g}">
    <div class="mk-top"><button class="mc-g g${g}" title="${L2("ربط", "Link group")}">${g || "–"}</button><span class="mc-n mono">${i + 1}</span>
      <select class="mc-sym">${all.map(x => `<option ${x === sym ? "selected" : ""}>${x}</option>`).join("")}</select>
      <select class="mk-tfsel">${TFS.map(x => `<option ${x === (MC.tfs[i] || MC.tf) ? "selected" : ""}>${x}</option>`).join("")}</select>
      <span class="mc-whyc"></span><span class="mk-st"></span><span class="mk-px"></span><span class="mk-chg"></span><button class="tb mk-open" title="Full chart">⤢</button></div>
    <div class="mk-chart"></div><div class="mk-conf"></div></div>`; }).join("");
  grid.querySelectorAll(".mc-cell").forEach(cell => {
    const i = Number(cell.dataset.i), el = $(".mk-chart", cell);
    const p = Object.assign(tileChart(el), {el: cell, i, sym: syms[i], lines: [], first: true});
    mcPanels.push(p);
    $(".mc-sym", cell).onchange = ev => mcSet(i, {sym: ev.target.value});
    $(".mk-tfsel", cell).onchange = ev => mcSet(i, {tf: ev.target.value});
    $(".mc-g", cell).onclick = () => { const g = MCG[(MCG.indexOf(MC.groups[i] || "") + 1) % MCG.length]; if (g) MC.groups[i] = g; else delete MC.groups[i];
      // joining a group adopts the symbol of the group's first panel
      const lead = mcPanels.find(q => q.i !== i && MC.groups[q.i] === g);
      mcSave(); if (g && lead) mcSet(i, {sym: lead.sym, tf: MC.tfs[lead.i] || MC.tf}); else { cell.dataset.g = g; $(".mc-g", cell).className = "mc-g g" + g; $(".mc-g", cell).textContent = g || "–"; } };
    $(".mk-open", cell).onclick = () => openSymbol(p.sym, MC.tfs[i] || MC.tf);
    el.ondblclick = () => { showView("workspace"); twSelect(p.sym, MC.tfs[i] || MC.tf); };
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < mcPanels.length; i += 4) await Promise.all(mcPanels.slice(i, i + 4).map(mcDraw));
}
async function mcDraw(p) {
  const tf = MC.tfs[p.i] || MC.tf;
  let d; try { d = await getJSON(`/api/chart/${p.sym}?tf=${tf}&bars=220`); } catch (e) { $(".mk-conf", p.el).innerHTML = `<span class="down">${esc(e.message)}</span>`; return; }
  if (!mcPanels.includes(p) || d.symbol !== p.sym) return;
  drawTile(p, d);
  $(".mc-whyc", p.el).innerHTML = mcWhy(p.sym);
}

def _find_symbol(text: str) -> str | None:
    t = text.upper().replace("/", "").replace(" ", "")
    alias = {"GOLD": "XAUUSD", "ذهب": "XAUUSD", "الذهب": "XAUUSD", "SILVER": "XAGUSD", "فضة": "XAGUSD", "الفضة": "XAGUSD",
             "BITCOIN": "BTCUSD", "BTC": "BTCUSD", "بيتكوين": "BTCUSD", "ETH": "ETHUSD", "NASDAQ": "NDX", "ناسداك": "NDX",
             "S&P": "SPX", "SP500": "SPX", "يورو": "EURUSD", "باوند": "GBPUSD", "ين": "USDJPY"}
    for s in config.UNIVERSE:
        if s in t:
            return s
    for k, v in alias.items():
        if k.upper() in t or k in text:
            return v
    return None


def _fallback(message: str, last: dict) -> dict:
    """No LLM connected: understand simple commands so the workspace still works."""
    from .. import markets
    sym = _find_symbol(message)
    tf = next((x for x in ("15m", "4h", "1h", "1d", "1w") if x in message.lower()), None)
    low = message.lower()
    actions = []
    if any(w in low for w in ("scan", "مسح", "حدث", "تحديث")):
        actions.append({"name": "start_scan", "args": {}})
    if any(w in low for w in ("english", "انجليزي", "إنجليزي")):
        actions.append({"name": "set_language", "args": {"lang": "en"}})
    if any(w in low for w in ("arabic", "عربي")):
        actions.append({"name": "set_language", "args": {"lang": "ar"}})
    if sym:
        actions.append({"name": "show_symbol" if any(w in low for w in ("اشرح", "حالة", "explain", "status")) else "open_chart",
                        "args": {"symbol": sym, "tf": tf or "1h"}})
        b = markets.brief(sym, tf or "1h", last)
        en = bool(re.search(r"[a-z]{3,}", low)) and not re.search(r"[؀-ۿ]", message)
        answer = "\n".join(b["text"]["en" if en else "ar"])
    elif actions:
        answer = "تمام، نفذت."
    else:
        answer = ("مفيش نموذج لغوي متوصل، فأنا بفهم أوامر بسيطة بس: اكتب اسم رمز (مثلاً: اشرح الذهب 4h، افتح EURUSD)، "
                  "أو «ابدأ المسح»، أو «English». للمحادثة الكاملة حط GEMINI_API_KEY في إعدادات Render.")
    return {"answer": answer, "actions": actions, "tools": [], "llm": False}

async def respond(history: list[dict], last: dict) -> dict:
    history = [m for m in history if m.get("role") in ("user", "assistant") and m.get("content")][-12:]
    if not history:
        return {"answer": "", "actions": [], "tools": [], "llm": llm.available()}
    if not llm.available():
        return await asyncio.to_thread(_fallback, history[-1]["content"], last)
    ctx = T.Ctx()
    ctx.cache["last"] = last
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}] + [{"role": m["role"], "content": str(m["content"])[:3000]} for m in history]
    schema = _schema()
    actions, used = [], []
    for step in range(7):
        final = step == 6
        try:
            msg = await asyncio.to_thread(llm.chat_tools, msgs, None if final else schema)
        except Exception as e:
            out = await asyncio.to_thread(_fallback, history[-1]["content"], last)
            out["answer"] = f"النموذج اللغوي مش متاح دلوقتي ({str(e)[:120]}).\n\n" + out["answer"]
            return out
        if not msg["tool_calls"] or final:
            return {"answer": msg["content"] or "تمام.", "actions": actions, "tools": used, "llm": True}
        msgs.append({"role": "assistant", "content": msg["content"] or None, "tool_calls": msg["tool_calls"]})
        for tc in msg["tool_calls"]:
            name = tc["function"]["name"]
            try:
                args = json.loads(tc["function"].get("arguments") or "{}")
            except Exception:
                args = {}
            try:
                if name in UI_TOOLS:
                    if "symbol" in args and args["symbol"] not in config.UNIVERSE:
                        raise ValueError("unknown symbol")
                    actions.append({"name": name, "args": args})
                    res = {"ok": True, "done_in_browser": name}
                elif name in EXTRA_TOOLS:
                    res = await asyncio.to_thread(_extra_call, name, args, last)
                else:
                    res, _ = await asyncio.to_thread(T.call, ctx, name, args)
                used.append(name)
            except Exception as e:
                res = {"error": str(e)[:300]}
            msgs.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.get("id", name), "content": T.dumps(res)[:12000]})
    return {"answer": "تمام.", "actions": actions, "tools": used, "llm": True}

  // overlay for trade box, S/R bands, structure zones and pattern lines (tilePaint): nothing is written on the price axis
